moy.f: Alternative form of Moi (“member of Montagnard people of Vietnam”).

s.g: (obsolete, geology) Flowing mud associated with a volcanic eruption (especially in South America), formed when snow or a lake near a volcano is disrupted, or when rain or steam mixes with soil or ash during an eruption.
(medicine) A disease in which certain arteries in the brain are constricted.

moyles.f: third-person singular simple present indicative of moyle
